cases.event: MATERIAL block references a member of another deck
preconditions: owner controls deck A
member belongs only to deck B
cases.recovery: quote a node of a member in the authorized deck snapshot

cases.event: MATERIAL block references a node that is not in the pinned item revision
preconditions: item revision changed after editor selection
cases.recovery: reload the current item revision and select a valid node

cases.event: exact attempt retry
preconditions: first scheduled submit committed one transition
cases.recovery: return the stored outcome without evaluator or reducer execution

cases.event: same attemptId with changed payload
preconditions: attempt receipt exists
cases.recovery: retain the original outcome and require a new presentation

cases.event: second attemptId for terminal presentation
preconditions: presentation already has a terminal receipt
cases.recovery: return the original terminal outcome reference

cases.event: client spoofs mode, roles, bindings or hintsUsed
preconditions: server presentation is PRACTICE with one assessed binding
cases.recovery: submit only the strict response envelope

cases.event: cancel
preconditions: active presentation has no receipt
cases.recovery: continue to the next bounded presentation

cases.event: evaluator unavailable
preconditions: active presentation evaluator cannot produce a result
cases.recovery: show retry-later feedback without recording incorrect evidence

cases.event: forward objective succeeds
preconditions: forward and reverse objectives have separate state
cases.recovery: none

cases.event: old epoch submit after restart
preconditions: presentation epoch is lower than current state epoch
cases.recovery: start a new session against the current epoch

cases.event: 100 replay or practice submissions
preconditions: server sessions are REPLAY or PRACTICE
cases.recovery: compact receipts expire after the retry window

cases.event: raw response expires
preconditions: scheduled raw row is older than submittedAt plus 30 days
cases.recovery: exact attempt retry returns the stored outcome without evaluation

cases.event: candidate generation not ready
preconditions: no READY generation exists for the pinned exercise root
cases.recovery: poll the bounded status resource before requesting presentations

cases.event: concurrent deck edit after session start
preconditions: session pins an immutable deck and exercise generation
cases.recovery: new sessions see the new deck revision

cases.event: client sends bindings or a second assessed subject
preconditions: the command carries bindings or more than one subject
cases.recovery: send one subject; the server derives the ASSESSED and CONTEXT bindings

cases.event: browse and reveal without assessed response
preconditions: material exists and owner is authorized
cases.recovery: none

cases.event: presentation expires before submit
preconditions: presentation expiresAt is before server clock
cases.recovery: request a current presentation; expiration is never incorrect evidence

cases.event: correct cloze answer after a server-recorded first-letter hint
preconditions: a study_hint_reveal row exists for one blank of the presentation
deterministic production evaluator returns CORRECT or PARTIAL
cases.recovery: none

cases.event: confidence differs for identical deterministic response
preconditions: response and presentation are otherwise identical
cases.recovery: none

cases.event: exact retry after raw response purge
preconditions: receipt remains and scheduled raw child row is absent
cases.recovery: return the durable stored outcome

cases.event: legacy mechanic name in a publication command
preconditions: a client still sends TYPED, LISTEN_TYPE, CLOZE_SINGLE, SINGLE_CHOICE, LISTEN_CHOICE or AUDIO_TEXT_MATCH
cases.recovery: publish one of the five canonical mechanics

cases.event: ai-semantic evaluator or TEXT_OR_SPEECH input while the capability is unavailable
preconditions: the capability flag is false, or true without a provider
cases.recovery: publish the deterministic variant

cases.event: learner presentation never carries an answer key
preconditions: a presentation of any mechanic is issued
cases.recovery: none

cases.event: media is not ready when an answer is submitted
preconditions: a pinned asset is not READY or its verified source is not the declared kind
cases.recovery: retry later with a new presentation
